value.rationale: A natural and nontrivial resource-constrained finite-model extension problem has a sharp computational dichotomy between a fixed allowed group exponent (polynomial) and a variable exponent (NP-complete), already for a single acyclic partial map on an unchanged carrier. The result meaningfully strengthens understanding of what unlimited finite-group extension existence cannot guarantee for exact finite universes.
